full_judgment:
9. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record for the accused-petitioners, citing the above-quoted portion of the judgment inevitably submits that the accused-petitioners' offence falls under Part 1 of section 304 and not under section 302 of the Penal Code. 

 12. Since this is not a case of culpable homicide not amounting to murder, falling within the definition of section 299 or within one of the five exceptions to section 300 of the Penal Code we cannot accept the submission of Mr. Md. Nawab Ali that  the accused-petitioners' guilt falls under Part I of section 304 of the Penal Code. It is clearly a case of murder with the intention of causing death by the act committed falling under the opening clause of section 300 of the Penal Code.
